output.reply: We are sorry for the trouble with this charge. We will review the annual plan payment and your cancellation record, and follow up with you as soon as we have checked it.

Thanks for reporting this, and we are sorry the notes with PDFs are not opening on iOS since the last update. Because your exam is on Friday, we have marked this as high priority and our team is looking into it. We will follow up as soon as we have more information.

Thanks for reaching out. Changing the email on your Lumen account requires verifying access, so we will help you update the address from your login details. We will follow up with the next steps shortly.
Thanks for flagging this, Maria. We will check the two $9.99 charges dated the 3rd and follow up with you about the duplicate.

Thanks for the suggestion. A dark mode that follows your system setting would save you the manual switch each evening, and we have passed it on to the product team. We cannot promise a timeline, but we appreciate you taking the time to tell us.

Thanks for reporting this. Pasting tables from Google Sheets into notes is not working as expected on Lumen web with Chrome 131, and we will look into it. In the meantime, you may be able to paste the table as plain text or use a different browser to check whether the issue persists.

We are sorry to hear this and take it seriously. Please change your password and turn on two-factor authentication right away, and check that the sharing settings on your notebooks are still correct. Our team will also review the unfamiliar login and sharing activity on your account.
You can share a notebook by opening it and selecting Share in the top bar, then entering the email addresses of the people you want to invite. Let us know if you run into any trouble with it.

Thanks for reaching out before your trip. We will confirm how to export your notes as Markdown files and send you the steps. If you need the backup sooner, tell us and we will help you as quickly as we can.

Thanks for sharing this. Being able to see who edited a note and when would help your team a lot, and we have passed your request on to the product team. In the meantime, you may want to keep copies of important notes so you can compare changes.
Thanks for reaching out. We will look into adding your company name and VAT number to invoices for Brandt Logistics GmbH and follow up with you shortly.
Thanks for reporting this. The word count in the footer shows 0 when a note contains only emoji, and we have noted it for the team to look at. We appreciate you flagging it.

Thanks for the suggestions. We have noted your requests for pinning notes to the top of a notebook, setting a default font size, and keeping trashed notes for 60 days instead of 30. We cannot promise if or when these will be added, but we will pass them to the product team.

Thanks for reporting this. We are sorry that sync has been stuck for three hours on both your phone and laptop, and that search is returning no results. We are looking into whether something on our side is causing these problems and will follow up with you as soon as we know more.

We are sorry you and your team cannot reach Lumen right before your presentation. We are investigating the 'Cannot reach server' error on your account now, even though the status page shows no incident, and we will update you as soon as we know more. In the meantime, please check whether your network or firewall is blocking Lumen, and let us know if the error persists.

Thanks for asking. You can update your display name in your profile settings, and the new name should then appear next to your comments. If the old nickname still shows after you save the change, let us know and we will take a closer look.
We are sorry you lost your meeting notes, and we understand how frustrating this is. We are looking into the save problem you described, and we will follow up once we have more information.

Sorry the recent update moved things around. Weekly summary emails are controlled from your email notification preferences in account settings. If you can't find the toggle there, reply to this ticket and we'll walk you through it.

Lamentamos que no puedas iniciar sesión y que no te llegue el correo de restablecimiento. Revisa también tu carpeta de spam y correo no deseado, y avísanos si el problema continúa para revisar tu cuenta.
We are sorry about the disruption your team is facing with the Error 503 since 9:15. We are checking this now and will share an update as soon as we know more.
Thanks for the suggestion. A home screen widget for Android is not available in Lumen yet, but we have noted your request for our product team. We appreciate you helping us shape what we build next.

Thanks for reporting this. We will check your Lumen Team upgrade, the $48 charge, and why the plan still shows as free. We will also look into why your two new teammates cannot see the shared notebooks, and follow up with you.

Thanks for reaching out, and good luck with your computer science degree. We don't have details about student pricing to share here, but we will check whether a discount is available for students and follow up with you. In the meantime, you can compare our plans on the pricing page to see which option fits your budget.

We're sorry the mobile app has been unavailable on Monday mornings, and we understand how disruptive that is. We're looking into the recurring 'temporarily unavailable' errors and will share an update as soon as we know more. Thank you for your patience while we investigate.

Thank you for the kind words and the detailed question. We will check how internal links behave when notes are moved and what happens to comments and edit history when notebooks are merged, then send you a clear answer. Until then, trying these steps on a copy of a small notebook is a safe way to see the results.

Bonjour, merci pour votre message. Nous allons vérifier où se trouve l'option de changement de carte dans votre abonnement et revenir vers vous. Nous vous recommandons de mettre à jour votre carte avant son expiration pour éviter toute interruption.

Thanks for reaching out, and we understand how urgent it is to get your legal documents today. We are reviewing your locked account and two-factor situation, and we will follow up with the next steps for verifying your identity. Please reply with any details that can help confirm your ownership of the account in the meantime.

Thanks for the detailed report. We have logged the freezing when opening notebooks with more than 200 notes and the Ctrl+B issue that sometimes inserts a literal 'b' on Windows desktop. Our team will look into both, and we may ask for your app version or a short screen recording if we need more detail.

Thanks for reporting this. Images showing as broken icons after an Evernote import is something we want to look into, and we will follow up on whether re-linking attachments is possible. In the meantime, re-importing the notes is a reasonable workaround to try.
Thanks for letting us know the app is slow today. We are looking into it and would appreciate any details you can share, such as what you were doing and which device or browser you use.

Thanks for reaching out about evaluating Lumen for your team. We have noted that Okta single sign-on via SAML is a hard requirement for your security team, and we will pass this to our product team. We cannot share a roadmap date yet, but our sales team can discuss your requirements and current options with you.

Sorry, that spellcheck underline on 'Lumen' is annoying. We have noted it and will look into adding the word to the spellcheck dictionary. In the meantime, you can usually right-click the word and choose Add to dictionary.

Thanks for reaching out about deleting your account. We will send you details on what gets removed and the expected timing, and walk you through the steps. If you want to keep any notes, please export them before you confirm the deletion.

Thanks for reporting this. We are sorry the share link at lumen.example/s/ab12 returns a 404 for your coworkers, and we will look into why shared notebook links are failing. We will follow up once we have more information.

Thanks for reporting this. Image uploads failing with the error you describe is something we are looking into, and text notes working is helpful to know. We will follow up as soon as we have more information.

Thanks for the suggestion. Sorting notes alphabetically is a reasonable request, and we have passed it on to the product team. We cannot promise if or when it will be added, but we appreciate you telling us.

Thanks for reaching out about the standup template. We are checking whether Lumen can save a note as a template and where to find that option, and we will follow up with the steps. Since your boss needs it by end of day, we are treating this as time-sensitive.
We are sorry about the charge after your cancellation. We will check your account and the payment made today, and follow up with you on what we find.

Thanks for reporting this, and we are sorry the charge caused an overdraft. We are checking the $480 charge against your expected $48 amount now and will follow up as soon as we have details. Please keep your bank records of this transaction in case they are needed.
Thanks for asking. We will check whether Lumen supports signing into a work and a personal account on the same phone and follow up with the steps.

Thanks for your questions. We will confirm how to turn on offline mode, whether it covers notebooks shared with you by teammates, and the storage included in the Plus plan. We will follow up with the answers shortly.

Thanks for the detailed report, and sorry the checkbox is toggling on scroll. We have noted the issue for Android version 5.2.1 and will look into it. In the meantime, you can avoid the problem by checking your to-do items after you finish scrolling.
Thanks for reporting this. Exact phrase search returning notes without the phrase is a real problem for your client work, and we are looking into it. We will follow up once we have more information.

Thanks for asking about switching to annual billing. We will check how the change would apply to your current monthly period and follow up with the details. We do not want to promise any specific charge timing before we have confirmed it for your plan.
Buenos días, gracias por escribirnos. Para cambiar el idioma de Lumen a inglés, abra Configuración en la app, elija Idioma y seleccione English.

Thanks for reaching out. Admin rights for a workspace are handled by our support team when the previous admin has left, so we will verify your organization and start the transfer process. Please reply with the name of the workspace and the email address of the person who will become the new admin.
You can change your password in your account settings under Security. If you cannot find the option or get stuck, reply here and we will walk you through it.

Thanks for reaching out. We will check whether merging your old Gmail account into your work account is supported and let you know what options are available. In the meantime, you can copy notes by hand if you need them right away.
Guten Tag, vielen Dank für Ihre Nachricht. Wir prüfen Ihre Anfrage zur Rechnung für Mai und senden Ihnen das PDF so bald wie möglich zu.

Thanks for reporting this. Please don't delete any notes yet, since your originals should still be there and we want to look into the duplicates safely. We are checking why each note appears twice in your notebook list and will follow up.

Thanks for the question. Right now pasted YouTube links show as plain text in notes, so embedding videos isn't something Lumen supports yet. We have passed your interest in video embeds to our team as a feature request.

Thanks for these suggestions. We have passed the word-count goal, the duplicate-note shortcut, the font options and the icon size to our product team for review. We appreciate you taking the time to share them.

We are sorry you lost your thesis notes. Please stop making other changes in that workspace for now, and check whether the notebook is in Trash or Recently deleted. We are reviewing whether it can be restored and will follow up as soon as we know more.

Thanks for the suggestion. Due dates on checklist items and a calendar view would make Lumen more useful as a task tracker, and we have passed your request to the product team. We will let you know if there are updates on this.

Thanks for reporting this. We are sorry that live editing is not showing changes between you and your colleague until a reload, while single-user editing works. We are looking into the collaboration issue and will share an update when we have more information.

Thank you for explaining how important audit-trail export is for your legal team and your renewal next quarter. We have noted this request, including the need for who, what and when details in an archivable format. I cannot confirm a build date, but I will make sure the product team sees how critical this is for your organization.

We are sorry you and your Berlin colleagues cannot log in before your investor call. We are checking the login failures now, and we will share an update as soon as we know more. If you can, please send the exact time of your last failed attempt so we can look into it faster.

We are sorry that reminder notifications stopped reaching your iPhone and that you missed two deadlines because of it. We are looking into the push notification problem, and reminders still appear in the app when you open it in the meantime.

We are sorry for the disruption this is causing your schools during class time. We are investigating reports of blank notebooks and repeated session expiry across your district and will share an update with your IT contact as soon as we know more. We will also send guidance on any workaround we can confirm in the meantime.

Thanks for the idea. Nested notebooks like Work > Clients > Acme would make organizing your notes easier, and we will pass this request to the product team. We cannot promise when or if it will be added, but your feedback is noted.
